flagship_project.name: Project HyperMesh: Sovereign Zero-Latency Multi-Rail Autonomous Clearing & Settlement Ledger with Quantum-Safe Signatures
flagship_project.pillar: Distributed Transaction Consensus & Dynamic Multi-Bank Route Optimization
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: India's UPI and card networks suffer bank-side degradation and downtime. HyperMesh is an autonomous algorithmic payment orchestrator that uses real-time bank health telemetry, self-healing routing fallbacks, and zero-knowledge idempotency to guarantee a 99.98% transaction success rate across 15,000 financial nodes.
flagship_project.tech_stack: Rust (Transaction Routing Engine), RocksDB + Raft Consensus (Local Embedded State), ClickHouse (Financial Audit Ledger), Apache Kafka, eBPF (Kernel-level Packet Bypass for Banking Gateways), HSM Post-Quantum Cryptography Modules
flagship_project.kpis: Sub-5ms payment gateway processing latency; 99.98% success rate across top 50 Indian banks; $8B daily processed GMV with 0 transaction loss.
